raw_response:
I have farmed this small piece for more than sixty years and I know what it needs. Last season I used the hybrid seed and fertilizer from the subsidy program, and the maize did well enough to fill our bellies, so I will plant the same way this year. I will put about half of one fertilizer bag on this plot and the rest on my other small piece, and my grandchildren will come to help with the digging and weeding. I do not have money for chemicals or irrigation, and at my age I cannot carry water anyway.
